description: This file contains Python code for generating CUDA kernel event handling code using Cutlass, including classes and functions for code generation, operation handling, and buffer management within the PyTorch _inductor compiler infrastructure.

classes.name: CutlassEVTOpsMixIn
classes.description: Mixin class providing static methods for various binary and unary operations, and dtype conversions used in CUDA code generation.

classes.name: MockCutlassHandler
classes.description: A passthrough handler class for cutlass operations, used during memory planning phases.

classes.name: CutlassEVTCodegen
classes.description: Main class responsible for generating Python code for CUDA event handling in the Cutlass-based codegen pipeline, managing buffer states, code blocks, and code finalization.

methods.name: scaled_mm_evt
methods.description: Creates event read names, buffer name mappings, and Python code for scaled matrix multiplication with optional bias.

methods.name: CutlassEVTOpsMixIn._infix_bin_op
methods.description: Returns a string representing an infix binary operation.

methods.name: CutlassEVTOpsMixIn._prefix_bin_op
methods.description: Returns a string representing a prefix binary operation.

methods.name: CutlassEVTOpsMixIn._prefix_un_op
methods.description: Returns a string representing a prefix unary operation.

methods.name: CutlassEVTOpsMixIn.to_dtype
methods.description: Converts a string to a specific dtype (identity in this stub).

methods.name: CutlassEVTOpsMixIn.constant
methods.description: Placeholder for constant conversion, not implemented.

methods.name: CutlassEVTOpsMixIn.mul
methods.description: Returns a string for multiplication operation.

methods.name: CutlassEVTOpsMixIn.truediv
methods.description: Returns a string for true division operation.

methods.name: CutlassEVTOpsMixIn.ge
methods.description: Placeholder for greater-than-or-equal operation, not implemented.

methods.name: CutlassEVTOpsMixIn.add
methods.description: Returns a string for addition operation.

methods.name: CutlassEVTOpsMixIn.relu
methods.description: Returns a string for ReLU activation.

methods.name: CutlassEVTOpsMixIn.sigmoid
methods.description: Returns a string for sigmoid activation.

methods.name: CutlassEVTOpsMixIn.sub
methods.description: Returns a string for subtraction operation.

methods.name: CutlassEVTOpsMixIn.tanh
methods.description: Returns a string for tanh activation.

methods.name: CutlassEVTOpsMixIn.exp
methods.description: Returns a string for exponential function.

methods.name: _AssignmentFormatter._default
methods.description: Handles operation dispatch, generating OpsValue or code lines for load/store operations.

methods.name: CutlassEVTCodegen.ir_to_evt_python_code
methods.description: Static method to generate Python code for CUDA event handling from IR nodes.

methods.name: CutlassEVTCodegen.get_value
methods.description: Returns the generated code as a string.

methods.name: CutlassEVTCodegen.finalize
methods.description: Finalizes code generation, renaming last store to 'D'.

methods.name: CutlassEVTCodegen.set_cur_node
methods.description: Context manager to set current node during code generation.

methods.name: CutlassEVTCodegen.get_renames
methods.description: Returns a dictionary of variable renames.

methods.name: CutlassEVTCodegen.get_reads
methods.description: Returns list of read variables.

methods.name: CutlassEVTCodegen.get_writes
methods.description: Returns list of written variables.

methods.name: CutlassEVTCodegen.load
methods.description: Loads a variable, adding to reads if necessary.

methods.name: CutlassEVTCodegen.store
methods.description: Stores a value, updating internal state.

methods.name: CutlassEVTCodegen._get_cur_node
methods.description: Returns current node being processed.

methods.description: Extracts index variables from a buffer node.

methods.name: CutlassEVTCodegen._get_current_index_vars
methods.description: Gets index variables for current node.

methods.name: CutlassEVTCodegen._check_indexing
methods.description: Checks if indexing matches buffer layout.

methods.name: CutlassEVTCodegen._stride_compatible
methods.description: Checks stride compatibility between index and buffer layout.
